thread:
Rae M: Heads-up 1 QBR prep: ops wants a short 'cost guard' appendix for three onboarding accounts (Helios, Parkside, Mistral). Goal: surface near-term renewal risk and quick mitigations.
Diego V: I'll grab Helios. Any required KPIs?
Rae M: Keep it tight. 1) 30d token trend + 7d spike calls, 2) top API routes by tokens, 3) suggested throttle presets and an email blurb. One slide per account.
Sanjay R: I'll take Parkside. I'll also check if embeddings are being overused in batch jobs.
Hannah F: Mistral -> I'll pull the per-request median and the recent function-calling samples. Also will tag any calls >10k tokens.
Rae M: Add a renewal flag rule: if 3 of {MoM burn up >25%, days of credits left <30, sudden spike >2x baseline} then mark "renewal-risk: amber". Put recommended next step (1: enable throttle, 2: send one-time buffer, 3: enable KV cache).
Diego V: For Helios, can we simulate a throttle where we cap context to 1024 and enable response truncation? Any tool for quick sim?
Sanjay R: Use the cost-sim lambda I pushed:
```
./bin/sim_spend --acct HELIOS --horizon 30 --cap_context 1024 --truncate 1 --out helios-sim.csv
```
Rae M: Nice. Add a column for "predicted days until credits". That helps CS prioritize.
Hannah F: Found two function-calling workflows for Mistral that balloon tokens: 'summarize_long_doc' and 'bulk_chat_import'. I'll flag them.
Sanjay R: Parkside has nightly embed rebuilds. That's 60% of their 7d spend. We should recommend moving to incremental rebuilds and adding a sampling window.
Diego V: Quick ask to DataOps: can you grant read to diego.v@redwood on helio-prod-billing? Need the last 90d raw events.
CostBot: access_request accepted: read granted to diego.v@redwood for project helio-prod-billing.
Rae M: We also have a small pre-approved retention buffer: $3k one-off credit if we can commit an optimization plan (doc + 2-week runbook). Add to slide.
Hannah F: I'll draft the enablement snippet, short and prescriptive:
"Hi <acct>, we noticed a recent spike driven by function-calls and nightly embed jobs. Quick wins: 1) cap context to 1024 for non-critical calls 2) switch embed rebuilds to incremental 3) enable model quantization for batch workloads. We can apply a one-time $3k credit if you accept a 2-week optimization pilot."
Sanjay R: Putting owners: Helios=Diego, Parkside=Sanjay, Mistral=Hannah, Enablement=Rae. Deliverables due Tue 4pm PT so I can paste into the QBR deck Wed.
Diego V: Doing sims now. Uploaded initial CSVs: https://drive.redwood/helios/helios-90d-sim.csv
CostBot: alert: helios burn increased 2.3x in last 7d (tag: spend-guard).
Rae M: Good callout. Add an action: automated alert to account owner + 24h auto-throttle to 50% if spike persists >48h.
Hannah F: Dry-run of the 5-slide appendix Thu 10am PT works for me.
Sanjay R: Also adding a one-liner for execs: "Top cause: heavy nightly embeddings; expected saving ~40% by switching to incremental + quantization." Keep it data-backed.
Rae M: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers with data access or sims, @here flag immediately. I'll assemble on Wed eve and send preview Thu morning. :rocket:
